scope: Bounded exact-code verification of six Danish pathology codes and five SKS imaging codes. Public codebook searches only; no local datasets transmitted and no phenotype or patient-level interpretation.

code_systems.pathology: Danish pathology SNOMED / patoSnoMed; not interchangeable with SNOMED CT identifiers
code_systems.sks: Sundhedsvæsenets Klassifikationssystem (SKS), Danish Health Data Authority

method.patobank: Read the official Patobank bone marrow/blood codebook and exact-code GET searches using searchbook=<code>&closed_codes=true; extracted matching table rows. Inclusion of closed codes was deliberate and does not establish current lifecycle status.
method.sks: Read the Danish Health Data Authority's SKS classification via its linked medinfo.dk publishing browser. Submitted public exact-code search forms (s_nod=0, ord empty, kode=<code>); extracted exact matching rows and their stable node links.
method.sks_data_version_observed: SKS browser states data last updated 30-09-2026; application version 4.06, updated 28-03-2026.
method.translation_note: English labels below are concise translations of the verified Danish code labels, not additional clinical assertions.

pathology.caveat: This is a topography code for marrow from the iliac crest. It does not alone establish a biopsy procedure or distinguish biopsy from aspirate. Prefer the anatomical label.
Topography label only; no test, method, result, or disease inferred.
Topography label only; no sampling procedure, method, result, or disease inferred.
The official code labels a bone marrow examination. It does not specifically identify flow cytometry; do not infer flow-cytometry availability from this code.
This is the published morphology-code meaning, not a complete patient-level disease definition. The legacy DLBCL label is contradicted by the official codebook.
The literal Danish code label is chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Do not silently broaden to additional entities or use this label as a complete patient phenotype.

sks.caveat: Procedure meaning only; no contrast status, indication, report, result, or image availability inferred.
Procedure meaning only; no contrast status, indication, report, result, or image availability inferred.
This specifies intravenous contrast, not a CT modality. Do not classify it as CT without a separately supported procedure context.
This specifies absence of intravenous contrast, not an MRI modality. Do not classify it as MRI without a separately supported procedure context.
Procedure meaning only; no report, findings, result, or image-pixel availability inferred.

summary.lifecycle_status: Historical effective dates and closure dates were not audited; verification concerns code meanings.
